votes.evidence_summary: REST insert accepts incorrect types with silent coercion: string to INT64, integer to VarChar, string to BOOL, violating strict type constraints
votes.rationale: three Type1 violations: the system should reject type mismatches for strongly-typed fields but instead accepts and coerces incorrect types (string for INT64, int for VarChar, string for BOOL), returning success when it should enforce strict type validation per the schema
